verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a SaaS code-review service, but the pack documents no public Bugbot API. The programmatic touchpoints are PR-comment triggers (`bugbot run`), repo-level `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` rules and machine-readable docs (llms.txt, .md pages); none of these is an API. Settings such as effort levels, Automatically Learn Rules, repository selection, analytics and org-wide Automations rules appear only as dashboard or UI controls, with no evidence they are exposed through an API.
